items.title: Safety

items:
Summary:

Welcome to an easygoing 30A retreat made for gathering, relaxing, and effortless beach days.



- Sleeps 37 | 10 bedrooms | 27 beds | 8 baths

- Private pool - heated seasonally Oct-May (nightly fee applies)

- Steps to public beach access w/ parking & wheelchair ramp

- Multiple living areas, kitchens & kitchenettes

- Outdoor courtyard w/ grill, balconies & Gulf views

- Pet-friendly & complimentary 6-passenger golf cart



The Space:

Salt air moves easily through wide decks as the Gulf stretches out nearby, shifting colors throughout the day. Mornings begin with quiet coffee on shaded balconies, afternoons drift between the courtyard pool and the beach just steps away, and evenings settle into relaxed conversation carried by coastal breezes.



Designed for large groups, this home offers space to gather and room to spread out across the main house and a private carriage house. Multiple living areas create natural places to reconnect or unwind, whether you are sharing meals, watching a movie, or enjoying quiet downtime. Thoughtful layouts and indoor-outdoor flow keep the home feeling social yet unhurried.



Sleeping arrangements

The property features ten bedrooms across the main house and carriage house, offering a mix of king beds, queen beds, twin beds, and custom bunk rooms. King suites are located on multiple levels, some with private balconies overlooking the Gulf. Bunk rooms include queen-over-queen bunks, queen beds paired with bunks, and stacked twin XL bunks. Bathrooms include ensuite, detached, and shared layouts, allowing flexibility for larger groups.



Living spaces

Four separate living rooms give everyone space to settle in. A first-floor living area with a kitchenette and wet bar opens directly to the courtyard. Upper levels include additional living rooms with seating, TVs, and access to balconies. The carriage house adds privacy with its own living room and wraparound balcony.



Kitchen and dining

The main kitchen is equipped for group meals, featuring stainless steel appliances, a gas range, granite countertops, a wine cooler, and two dishwashers. A large dining table and bar seating support shared meals. A second full kitchen in the carriage house and additional kitchenettes make it easy to manage cooking across a full house.



Outdoor living

A private courtyard surrounds the pool, which is heated seasonally from October through May for an additional nightly fee. Lounge seating, outdoor furniture, and a grill create a relaxed setting for afternoons and evenings. Decks, patios, screened porches, and balconies throughout the home offer constant access to fresh air and Gulf breezes.



Location and access

A brand-new public beach access is just steps away and includes parking, restrooms, and a wheelchair ramp, with lifeguards on duty during peak season. A complimentary six-passenger street-legal golf cart makes exploring along 30A simple, with nearby dining and shopping options close by.



Additional details

The home is pet-friendly, offers free parking on the premises, and supports long-term stays of 28 days or more. Self check-in is available via smart lock, and events are allowed with an additional fee.



Guest Access:

We offer convenient door codes for self-check-in. 850 Vacation Rentals by Portoro uses convenient keyless entry for self check-in, details provided 2 weeks (or less) prior to arrival by email and text message.



• Early check-ins or late check-outs: If the property happens to be ready earlier than the standard 4 pm check-in time on the day of your arrival, in most cases an early arrival option may be available when confirmed with the main office. Late check-outs must be confirmed with main office staff prior to the date of departure.



Available for Events (See Other Things to Note for fees/terms.)

- Weddings

- Reunions

- Corporate Functions

- Multiple Family Gatherings



Included Golf Cart Guidelines and Use

- A golf cart is available at the property for guest use by our 3rd party rental partner, Destin Florida Golf Cart Rentals, LLC. You agree to complete a waiver document regarding the use and liability of the golf cart which will be completed with Destin Florida Golf Cart Rentals, LLC provided by QR code listed at the property and in your check-in details, prior to the release of the cart access activation code.



The Neighborhood:

South Walton County's Santa Rosa Beach is located along Florida's Northwest Coast, just east of Destin. One of the oldest 30A coastal towns. You'll enjoy gorgeous state parks, delicious restaurants, and a thriving region for artists. Out of the water? Parks, museums, local galleries, and family-friendly adventures await! With fishing, scuba diving, snorkeling and sand castles, Santa Rosa Beach is the ultimate 30A beach vacation experience!



Things to See:

• Local Experiences:

• Local Restaurants & Shopping

- Restaurants: Bud and Alley's Waterfront Restaurant and Rooftop Bar, Hooked Sea to Table, Down Island Gulf Seafood Restaurant, Louis Louis, The Bay

- Shops: The District, Retail Therapy of Santa Rosa Beach, Uptown Grayton, Gulf Place Town Center, Seagrove Plaza & more!



Annual Festivals & Events:

• The Big Chill on 30a

• 30A Songwriters Festival

• Sandestin Gumbo Festival

• South Walton Beaches Wine & Food Festival

• WaterColor Film Festival

• Harvest Wine and Food Festival

• Fourth of July on 30A

• Gulf Coast Jam



We provide a full list of Things to Do & See and local Restaurants & Shops to experience for our guests including in a personalized Guest Manual in your check-in details provided prior to your stay!



S. Walton County (Miramar Beach, FL) Short-Term Rental Registration No. #



Getting Around:

You'll find that Santa Rosa Beach provides easy access to dining, shopping, and nightlife entertainment. Guests have access to several beaches in the region! Bikes/Cycling or taking public transportation are alternate options (Major corridors in close proximity to South Walton include: I-65, I-55, I-10, and US Hwy 331). While you may be traveling by your/rental vehicle, if you need additional transportation or nearest airport information, we have you covered!



Traveling to/around Santa Rosa Beach, Florida:

• Taxi Cabs [i.e., Panhandle Transportation Group, Miramar Beach Shuttle, Marcowhale Limo Shuttle and Tax Service]

• Uber, Lyft

• Bike/Cycling [Rentals: Coastal Cruisers, Fun Pug Bike Rentals, Runaway Rentals, Sweet Escape Rentals]



Airports:

• Destin-Fort Walton Beach Airport (VPS) [35 miles north-northwest of downtown Destin]

• Northwest Florida Beaches International Airport (ECP) [35 miles east of Destin]



Popular Landmarks:

• Grayton Beach State Park

• Topsail Hill Preserve State Park

• Shell Island

• Fort Walton Heritage Park and Cultural Center

• Deer Lake State Park

• Seaside Beach



Interaction with Guests:

Our goal is that your vacation exceed your expectations. 850 Vacations by Portoro communicates via email and phone. After a booking is confirmed, rental agreement will be emailed to the guest for e-signature. Check-in instructions are sent by email and text message 14 days (or less) prior to arrival date. We offer convenient keyless entry for self-check in. We do typically check in with guests by text 1-2 times during their stays to ensure a 5-star experience and remain available for any questions. We are available to guests 24/7 for any inquiries.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
